## Summary
Detects and sizes LKTS packet trailers at the end of RTP payloads. The package validates trailer eligibility using the RTP marker flag, a magic suffix, and an XORed trailer length byte.

## Responsibilities
- Define the LKTS trailer magic suffix and trailer envelope constants.
- Detect whether an RTP payload ends with an eligible packet trailer.
- Return the number of bytes that should be stripped from packet payloads.
